31 Years of UFC Judging Data (1995–2026) · Round-by-Round Scoring & Dissent

Chapter 1 · The Core Discovery

When two cage-side judges agree on a round, which third judge breaks away most often?

Across 31,881 individual rounds evaluated by 3-judge panels, exactly 2,362 rounds (7.41%) produced a lone dissenting judge. Among high-volume UFC mainstays (250+ rounds), Cardo Urso ranks #1 with a 9.32% round dissent rate, followed by Glenn Trowbridge (8.83%) and Rick Winter (8.75%).

Chapter 4 · Empirical Context

The Anatomy of a UFC Round (1995–2026)

10-8 Dominant Rounds: 1,200 (3.76%)
10-10 Even Rounds: 154 (0.48%)
